Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Asigurări
The Opportunity 
 We are looking for an IT Infrastructure Specialist to keep our local business running smoothly. You will be the go-to person for resolving IT issues and requests quickly, while working with global suppliers and support teams, from server to application support, to make sure all services perform within agreed parameters. You will report directly to the IT Infrastructure Manager and join an inclusive, multicultural team where your ideas make a real impact.
 Key Responsibilities 
Provide L2/L3 support for end-user infrastructure and applications.
Diagnose and resolve hardware, network, application, and voice technology issues.
Resolve ServiceNow tickets on time and within SLA, and guide users to raise tickets with the right support groups.
Administer Windows Servers in scope.
Support the IT Risk & Security team by remediating known vulnerabilities and applying security patches.
Collaborate with third-party providers to resolve issues.
Support Global Teams in deploying infrastructure and application changes.
Support the local business during end-of-month activities.
Use AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) responsibly to speed up troubleshooting, documentation, and routine task automation.
 Required Qualifications 
 Experience 
3-5 years in IT Infrastructure and/or IT Support roles.
Experience working in multicultural, regional teams.
 Technical skills 
Working knowledge of ITIL and process-driven service delivery.
Active Directory.
Windows Server administration.
Network operations and hardware (Cisco routers and switches).
 AI fluency 
Practical, hands-on use of AI assistants (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude) in daily work, such as drafting solutions, analyzing logs or errors, and creating knowledge articles.
Ability to write clear prompts, critically validate AI outputs, and apply AI within data privacy and security guidelines.
Curiosity and openness to adopting AI-enabled and automated ways of working.
 Soft skills 
 Strong communication and customer-oriented mindset.
Time management and resilience under tight deadlines.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Attention to detail and awareness of the impact of infrastructure changes.
Fluent English, written and spoken.
 Preferred Qualifications 
VMware knowledge.
MS SQL configuration and scripting.
PowerShell scripting, including using AI to generate, review, and improve scripts.
Experience or desire to automate repetitive IT tasks (e.g., with Power Automate or Copilot Studio).
 What We Offer 
Friendly and collaborative work environment with strong career development opportunities.
Learning and development programs tailored to your needs and goals, including AI upskilling.
Inclusive and multicultural team where your ideas can make an impact.
Competitive benefits package including flexible hours, annual performance bonus, private medical subscription, life and health insurance, Bookster, flexi benefits monthly budget and additional holidays.
Excellent office location (Piata Victoriei Square) and hybrid working capabilities.
 At Metropolitan Life, part of MetLife, Inc, one of the largest life insurance companies in the world, we’re leading the global transformation of an industry we’ve long defined. United in purpose, diverse in perspective, we’re dedicated to making a difference in the lives of our customers. 
 Metropolitan Life is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer committed to attracting, retaining, and maximizing the performance of a diverse and inclusive workforce.
